description: This file contains architecture-specific kernel functions and inline routines for the Xtensa architecture in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, context switching, and cache management.

methods.name: arch_kernel_init
methods.description: Initializes architecture-specific kernel settings, including cache, stack, and CPU state.

methods.name: arch_switch
methods.description: Performs a context switch to another thread or task.

methods.name: arch_cohere_stacks
methods.description: Ensures cache coherency between old and new thread stacks during context switches.

methods.name: arch_is_in_isr
methods.description: Checks if the current execution context is within an interrupt service routine.
